item.title: Omni One VR Treadmill Joins ‘Made for Meta’ Program, Opening Door to Quest Compatibility
item.description: Virtuix announced it’s joined the Made for Meta program, which opens the door to bring official Quest compatibility to the company’s Omni One VR treadmill. Made for Meta is a hardware partnership that certifies that accessories not only work with Meta devices, but also meet the company’s quality standard.
